title: constrain-discovers-and-runs-the-instruments-that-will-judge-the-build
intention: constrain hands the builder the answers it would otherwise go and fetch — starting with the instruments that will judge this work, DISCOVERED rather than listed, RUN rather than named, and reported with their state right now — so that a lookup happens once in the floor instead of N times in the ceiling.
why:
AKIEN'S, 2026-08-14, verbatim, and the four clauses are load-bearing in order: 'that sounds like a plan. so the intention is this component can give you the same kinds and amounts of information you'd give youself. that it replaces those tool calls for you. why: because we can. because it gets us measurably closer to running those components for you and without you. and to keep learning, not to become fixed. because it's an easy one to get right before moving mon to harder ones.'

MEASURED behind it, over this session's own transcript, n=1 on a complete recorded build: 1251 tool calls, of which 924 are Bash. 681 of those 924 (73%) are lookups in the tree or runs of a standing check — reads, not work. 300 Bash calls re-asked an address already asked in the same session; 169 distinct addresses were looked up and 35 of them four or more times (transitions.py 26x, orient.py 13x, inspector.py 11x). A settled answer re-derived is Law 1's defect by definition, and this is it counted rather than asserted.

THE REFRAME, and it is what makes this constrain's work rather than a caching idea: everything that actually constrained this morning's build was PHYSICS, and constrain collects exclusively PROSE. The entry gate that refused the BUILDME crossing, the judge that refused all six constraint sources, the rung move that had silently retired a fixture's world — none of them appear in any charter's falsifier text, and all three were met by tripping over them after the work was done. So the question changes from 'what bounds this?' to 'what will refuse this?' — a lookup, which is what makes it a floor question. A charter's falsifier is a TRANSLATION of a constraint; the check that enforces it IS the constraint (Law 4), and a constraint that is a runnable check can be RUN at stage 2 rather than quoted.
traces_to: Akien's ruling of 2026-08-14 on constrain's intention (quoted whole in `why`) — the intention itself is his and this ticket implements it rather than proposing it.

Ruling 2026-08-14-the-preamble-compiles-to-learn-not-to-be-cheap — the build order is his: orient, then constrain, then survey, and the other four wait on these three WORKING. This is the constrain rung deepened, and it precedes survey.
Law 1 — the resolver is spent on the novel, not on re-deriving the settled. 300 re-asked addresses in one session is that defect counted.
Law 4 — a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy. The reframe IS this law: the check that enforces a bound is the bound, and the prose is its translation.
Law 3 — nothing is known until measured. 'Is this check currently green' is answerable only by running it, which is why the floor runs rather than names.

falsifier.proves_green: IN: constrain's floor gains discovered, RUN checks as constraints of a NEW KIND (no new packet field — these ARE constraints, and a constraint whose source is a runnable check is the same thing said in physics); the crowding-out probe's predicate is corrected to ask the floor which kinds it produces instead of spelling 'charter' as a literal; proofs for both; constrain's charter. THREE BOUNDS ON THE IMPLEMENTATION: (1) THE SET IS DISCOVERED AT FIRE TIME FROM DISK, never enumerated — Akien's third clause, and a check that appears next month must appear in the packet with no edit. (2) THE FLOOR RUNS WHAT IS REACHABLE FROM THE REFS AND SAYS HOW IT CHOSE — the tester alone is 106 proofs and a preamble that costs more than the build is a worse answer than the lookups it replaced. (3) THE FLOOR READS VERDICTS AND GATES NOTHING; the crossings keep their own authority (Law 6). OUT and stated: the four other categories CC proposed and Akien did not scope (measurements of the changed data, precedent-transfer, recent rulings, interop contracts) — each is a separate rung and the first to earn a measurement gets built next; survey and the rest of the chain; the dial; anything on hex.local; and any change to a judging component to make it easier to discover — the floor adapts to the instruments, never the reverse.
falsifier.proves_red: DONE when a constrain packet berths carrying checks the floor DISCOVERED and RAN, at least one of them reported with a state the floor measured rather than assumed, and the crowding-out probe's arithmetic no longer counts those checks as the ceiling's contribution. THREE HOLLOW PASSES, each with its tooth: (1) THE FLOOR EMITS A LIST OF CHECK NAMES — that is a briefing, it is what the charter prose already was, and it passes any test that counts entries. The tooth requires a check reported as judging this build to be one that ACTUALLY RUNS at its crossing, proved by taking a check the floor named and confirming the same identity appears in a real crossing's record. (2) THE FLOOR REPORTS EVERY CHECK GREEN BECAUSE IT NEVER RAN THEM. The tooth mutates the tree — break something a discovered check covers — and requires the floor's report to go red for that check and stay green for the others; a report that cannot go red is the constant this component already shipped once and caught. (3) THE LIST IS A HAND-WRITTEN CONSTANT THAT HAPPENS TO BE RIGHT TODAY. The tooth adds a proof file at a ref'd address in a fixture and requires it to APPEAR in the floor's output with no code change. WRONG INTENT if an oracle is consulted anywhere on this path — bin/cmd/determinism must keep reading this component PURE DETERMINISTIC and REFUSES GATE.
falsifier.horizon: One build, and it is bounded by the checks half only. The three follow-on categories are named OUT above and each owes its own measurement before it is built.
